english.title: Intend to influence another person to vote in a particular way or refrain from voting whilst with them at polling booth
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 62C(1) and (4) of the Representation of People Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

intended to influence them to vote in a particular way/refrain from voting

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) 'Polling booth' means a compartment in a polling station in which voters can mark votes screened from observation (section 62C(3)(a)) of the Representation of the People Act 1983).
(ii) Assisting a person with voting in accordance with any legislation is not 'influencing' the person to vote in a particular way or refrain from voting (section 62C(3)(b)).
(iii) This offence does not have effect in relation to an election in Wales under the Local Government Act 1972 (section 62C(5)).
